title: Summary of Claims and Source Quotes
lead: The hit list has been downloaded and is awaiting a secure network zone.
summaryOneLine: The hit list has been downloaded and is awaiting a secure network zone.
articleBodyHtml:
Hit List Downloaded

The hit list has been downloaded and is awaiting a secure network zone.

Keyboard Status

The keyboard is broken and not working.

Aggressive Action

Be aggressive.

Observation Made

They observed something.

Multiple Mentions of 'Crypto Money Maker'

Multiple mentions of 'Crypto Money Maker'.

Initial Problem Encountered

They encountered an initial problem.

Team Ready to Act

チームは準備完了。行動を開始。

Crypto Maker and 000

Someone is trying to make a cryptocurrency, and they are asking if the speaker wants to try 000 again.

Hiding from Brenning

They are trying to hide from Brenning.

Operation Success

The team successfully intercepted and ran the operation.

Technical Components Discussion

Characters are discussing various technical components and systems.

Stabilizing a Solution

To stabilize a solution, first lay it flat horizontally, then turn it left once.

Indicators and Charge

Two indicators lit up, with a total charge of two.

Time to Proceed

They have time to proceed.

Available Connectors

The available connectors are two greens and one black.

Long Part from Square

A long part extends from the right part of the square.

Time Pressure

The team is under time pressure.

Acknowledgement

Acknowledgement

Battery Backup Discussion

They are discussing battery backup.

Speaker Not on Train

The speaker and another person are discussing a situation where the speaker doesn't appear to be on the train.

Halfway Point and Mission Options

They discuss the halfway point and options for continuing the mission.

Invitation and Gratitude

Someone (ひなた) is invited to sit down and expresses gratitude to Senpai for their support.

February 21st Event

A February 21st event is ongoing and select entries will be shown on an upcoming Raider review.

Virus Mention

Someone said "That's virus."

relatedStreams.title: Discussion about Choosing a Song to Sing
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: They are discussing which song to sing. One person suggests 'Dry Flower,' while another suggests 'Attack No. 1.' There is some disagreement about whether 'Attack No. 1' is a ballad.

relatedStreams.title: 自動編成に任せきらない　IRySが『CookieRun: Kingdom』初見で作ったチーム
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 自動編成は完成した答えではなく、配置、回復、スキル優先、新キャラへの愛着をプレイヤーが調整する出発点だと分かる

relatedStreams.title: IRySが「ゆるホロチームカート」で初の1位　16人で走った年末の『マリオカート ワールド』
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: IRySが16人参加の「#ゆるホロチームカート」で『マリオカート ワールド』に挑戦。個人戦で自身初という1位を獲得し、チーム戦や雑談を経て新春ゲーム祭の告知まで進んだ。

relatedStreams.title: heroを送る側へ回ったIRyS　『Dispatch』初見で見つけたZ-Team再出発の仕事
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 物語の全要約ではなく、IRySが『Dispatch』の仕事を理解し、能力値と感情の両方でZ-Teamを選ぶようになる変化を追える
